# Data Source Analysis: BLS Consumer Price Index Feed

The public BLS API responded successfully with valid data. Series CUUR0000SAF1 reports "Food at home" (a Consumer Price Index measuring the relative price level of groceries against a reference baseline) at an index value of "350.905" for September 2026, with a twelve-month change of 2.48% from the September 2025 value of "342.405". This series measures a *price level*, not a dollar amount or household spending figure—an index of 350.905 means prices for this category are approximately 3.5 times their value in the reference period (typically 1982–1984 = 100).

It does not represent dollars spent by households or the total food budget—those would require the Consumer Expenditure Survey. A 2.48% annual increase in this index indicates that the relative price of groceries has risen modestly year-over-year.
